items.html: And it is therefore found that in this aspect the worth of ZA grows, for he nurses from the Keter itself of Arich Anpin, through the thirteen white ones that come out of it. But Aba and Ima nurse only from the Hochma of Arich Anpin, through the thirteen Tikunim of the beard drawn from it. Nevertheless, in respect of the fact that he does not receive the influence of Arich Anpin itself except through Aba and Ima, who clothe Arich Anpin, while he clothes them, in this aspect Aba and Ima are greater than ZA.
